summary: An excerpt from the novel 'Book 1 — part 17' (a fiction source) in which the narrator, Darryl, Van and Jolu are in a chaotic urban emergency. Darryl is badly wounded and bleeding, phone lines are jammed, and the group tries to flag down emergency vehicles on Market Street. Their attempts fail until a military-looking Jeep with no insignia stops, and armed men in coveralls and gas masks emerge.
one_line: Wounded Darryl and his friends try to flag down emergency vehicles on Market Street during a jammed-phone crisis, until an unmarked military Jeep appears.
key_facts: The narrator punched 911 on his phone but got a sound like a whimper of pain from the phone system rather than a busy signal.
The narrator compares the jammed 911 line to the load from three million people dialing the same number at once.
Jolu suggested calling 911 and then Wikipedia, but the group had no phone or data service.
Darryl pointed out the cop cars, ambulances and firetrucks passing every five seconds on the street.
Darryl dragged himself down toward Market Street after the narrator argued briefly with Vanessa.
An ambulance, a cop car, a firetruck and the next three cop-cars all drove past without slowing down.
Darryl was white-faced and panting, and Van's sweater was soaked in blood.
The narrator stepped into the road waving his arms and shouting STOP when the next car appeared on Market Street.
The stopping vehicle was a military-looking Jeep, like an armored Hummer, with no military insignia.
The narrator jumped back, lost his balance and ended up on the road in front of the Jeep.
Armed men in coveralls with big, bulky rifles and hooded gas masks with tinted face-plates got out of the Jeep.
